r_addition_permit_lead.subject: permit_lead_times
r_addition_permit_lead.content: Every permit application is filed 2 weeks before job start — except TDEC septic, which is filed 6 weeks before; demo never starts without the building permit in hand.

r_addition_septic_scope_only.subject: septic_trigger
r_addition_septic_scope_only.content: TDEC septic permitting applies only when the job modifies or installs a septic system — added bedrooms or bathrooms alone do not trigger it; never break ground while TDEC is pending.

r_addition_window_order.subject: procurement_windows
r_addition_window_order.content: Windows and exterior doors are ordered at permit submittal; any non-stock size is verified for real lead time before the schedule assumes stock.

r_addition_weathertight_gate.subject: weathertight_gate
r_addition_weathertight_gate.content: Interior work begins only once roofing is complete, and insulation/drywall are never scheduled before rough inspections pass.

r_addition_roof_tiein_photos.subject: roof_tie_in
r_addition_roof_tiein_photos.content: When a new roof ties into or over-frames an existing roof, existing conditions are photo-documented on day one of roof framing.

r_addition_service_capacity.subject: electrical_capacity
r_addition_service_capacity.content: Existing main-service capacity is verified before any subpanel or HVAC equipment order is placed; a subpanel rides the building permit, a main-service upgrade is its own permit.
